summary: MDA Space Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K with interim condensed consolidated financial statements, MD&A, CEO/CFO certifications and a press release for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Revenue rose to C$498.1M for the quarter from C$409.8M, with net income of C$30.9M and diluted EPS of C$0.19. Cash climbed to C$2,153.8M from C$152.0M at December 31, 2025, reflecting a large financing inflow. This is a routine quarterly reporting filing with no special-situation transaction announced.
